about: [C7 critic] the loud pass, idle and holding W: (1) hands off where it begins (the catwalk by the office): does waiting win, or does the telephone's answerer find me, warned? (2) back there: down the west stairs and straight across the lit floor to the bay holding W, never shooting: down in seconds, warned, the reason said?

steps.eval: (window.W = () => G.scenes.ctx.flags.live, window.LOG = [], G.on('fail', (e) => LOG.push({ why: e.why, t: +G.time.toFixed(1), at: [+N.controller.pos.x.toFixed(1), +N.controller.pos.z.toFixed(1)] })), window.T0 = G.time, 1)
JSON.stringify({ at: [N.controller.pos.x.toFixed(1), N.controller.pos.z.toFixed(1)], hp: G.health.hp, obj: G.hud.kit.objText, teach: G.hud.kit.teachCur && G.hud.kit.teachCur.text })
JSON.stringify({ secs: +(G.time - T0).toFixed(1), warn: G.hud.kit.warnText, loud: !!W().loud, ans: W().answerer && W().answerer.name })
